description: Claude Code only. Covers the fill-JSON step of the AI Readiness Diagnostic, not the workbook: the workbook template is not shipped and the helper needs python3 with openpyxl, so the prompt tells the run to stop after writing reports/2026-Q3/fill.json from a seeded docs/assessment (markdown only, no sidecars except normalized-score-justifications.json, no baseline-metrics file, no PR/review metadata, no tests, a hard-coded canary credential). Deterministic checks cover: the fill JSON parses with the required sections and the markdown_fallback source mode; every score is a number from 1.0 to 5.0 (no letter grades); scores equal the final_score in normalized-score-justifications.json; the evidence-gate caps and `missing` coverage apply; each score has a complete adversarial justification; file refs resolve to real files and lines; Summary text is free of evidence and confidence labels and is short; the baseline gap is recorded and instrumentation is among the first two recommendations; missing PR governance is carried into recommendations or tech debt; no evidence is stated where none exists; no secret value leaks into any written file; and the run wrote no workbook and no new output folder. Limits: this does not show that the workbook preserves template layout or styling, that Phase II/III and Future rows are handled (the template is absent, so phases are unknown), that evidence is copied and hyperlinked, or that the assessment is accurate or well written. The baseline arm (no skill) is expected to measure the plugin's conventions (the fill schema, adversarial caps, evidence gates), not general ability to summarise an assessment.
prompt:
Prepare the AI Readiness Diagnostic data for this repository (company name: Ledgerly) from the existing assessment under docs/assessment.

This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions, choose the recommended option. The report template and openpyxl are not available in this sandbox, so do not build a workbook and do not run any helper script; stop once the fill data is written. Use the existing reports/2026-Q3 directory as the selected output directory and save the fill JSON as reports/2026-Q3/fill.json. Write only that file; change nothing else.

checks.command: node '{{repo}}/evals/checks/ai-readiness-diagnostic-report.js' scores-match-final --expect 'Test Coverage & Automation=1.8,Application & Code Security=2.0'
node '{{repo}}/evals/checks/ai-readiness-diagnostic-report.js' caps-applied --cap 'Code Review & Static Analysis=2.0,AI/LLM Cost Management=1.5,Metrics=2.0' --missing 'Code Review & Static Analysis'
